test: NFR-05 recovery on the live release (07faec1)
method: Signed in as a demo mentee, sent a mentorship request, powered the Aiven database off from the Aiven console, waited, powered it on, and probed GET /api/mentorship-requests every 10 seconds from the browser throughout. No server was restarted by hand.

results.alumnet_recovery_after_database_returned: within one 10 s probe interval (13 s between the last failure and the first success), with no manual restart
results.matching_after_recovery: worked; the first recommendation request took 18.3 s while the matching service reconnected and warmed up
results.error_shown_during_outage: HTTP 500 'Something went wrong' (fixed afterwards: the server now answers 503 'AlumNet cannot reach its database right now' and pages show a reconnecting notice)

cleanup: The test request (id 15, to demo mentor Catherine Akinyi) was withdrawn after the check.
